sources.title: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) is a technique for training a pair of neural network models, one for image understanding and one for text understanding, using a contrastive objective. [1] This method has enabled broad applications across multiple domains, including cross-modal retrieval, [2] text-to-image generation, [3] and aesthetic ranking. [4]
